title: claude-workflow config
description: claude-workflow config: global.config.json plus repository/<repo-name>.config.json (<repo-name> = the repo folder name). Merge rule: the repo file overrides the global file. Objects (such as 'commands' or 'stages') merge key by key, one level at a time; arrays and plain values (strings, numbers, booleans, null) are replaced as a whole. Check with 'claude-workflow config check'.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

kb-path.description: Knowledge-base folder, mounted read-only for Explore, Plan and Review. '~' is expanded.

flake-path.description: Folder with the flake.nix whose dev shell is used by commands with run-in 'sandbox' (Implement and Verify). null: no dev shell.

docker-host.description: Docker socket of the separate rootless daemon, as 'unix:///absolute/path'. Every docker call of the workflow gets it as DOCKER_HOST. null or absent: Docker steps stop (NEEDS_HUMAN); the workflow never uses root Docker.

worktree-base.description: Folder that holds the ticket worktrees. '~' is expanded. Absent: a 'worktrees' folder in the workflow state folder.

commands.description: Named commands. Verify runs them (see 'verify'), and Plan/Review list them by name in tests.txt as '<name> [parameter=value ...]'.

verify.description: Commands that Verify always runs, in this order, before the tests listed in tests.txt.

shared-dependencies.description: Dependency folders shared read-only from the main checkout into the worktree, only when the lockfile is identical.

dir.description: Folder, relative to the repository root, e.g. 'legacy/vendor'.

lockfile.description: Lockfile that decides the folder's content, e.g. 'legacy/composer.lock'.

docker-compose.description: The Docker Compose project of this repository: 'the compose stack'. Commands with needs-compose-stack: true make the workflow run 'docker compose up' for it first (from the worktree). null or absent: no compose stack.

project-name.description: Compose project name (docker compose -p). The workflow stack runs in a separate rootless daemon, so it does not share containers or volumes with your own stack, even with the same name. 'docker compose ls' shows it.

up-timeout.description: How long 'docker compose up --wait' may take. Image builds get 10 minutes extra.

protected-paths.description: Extra glob patterns (fnmatch; '*' also matches '/') of files that must equal the base commit before the stack starts. The defaults (compose files, .env*, Dockerfiles, .gitattributes, ...) and the scripts of 'host' commands are always protected.

path.description: Folder, relative to the repository root.

include.description: Only files whose name matches one of these globs (fnmatch) are copied, e.g. ['*.crt'] to leave private keys behind. Symlinks are skipped.

host-copies.description: Gitignored folders the stack mounts, copied from the main checkout before 'up'. They are hidden from every sandbox (they may hold keys). An entry is a path, or {"path": ..., "include": [globs]} to copy only matching files.

services.description: Compose services to start: only these and what they depend_on. Recommended: list what the tests need, so unrelated services (and their image builds) are not started. Absent: every service of the profile.

create-dirs.description: Gitignored folders the stack mounts that only need to exist (the app fills them).

max-escalations.description: How often Plan/Implement may ask the human a question.

max-fix-rounds.description: How often Verify/Review may send the ticket back to Implement.

headless-timeout.description: Time limit for one headless Claude call.

commit-no-verify.description: Skip git hooks for the final commit.

stages.description: Per-stage settings. Only list what differs from the defaults.

name.description: kebab-case name; ':' allowed for groups, e.g. 'tests:api'.

duration.description: A duration with its unit: '90s', '15m' or '2h'.

description.description: What the command does. Shown to Claude when it picks tests.

run-in.description: Where the command runs. 'sandbox': in bubblewrap with the flake dev shell and no network (like the agent). 'host': on your machine, outside the sandbox; the script it starts is protected like the compose files and the base-commit copy is run. 'container': 'docker exec' into an already running container (it does not need docker compose).

command.description: The command line. '{{parameter-name}}' is replaced by the parameter's value (with 'format' applied), or removed when the parameter is empty.

working-directory.description: Folder relative to the repository root to run in. Default: the repository root. Changed files given to this command are made relative to it.

needs-compose-stack.description: Start the compose stack (see 'docker-compose') before running, if it is not up for this worktree.

needs-git.description: For run-in 'sandbox': mount a throwaway 'git init' folder instead of hiding .git (for tools such as pre-commit that need a git repo).

container.description: Container name for run-in 'container' (docker ps shows it).

user.description: uid[:gid] for run-in 'container'. Without it, docker exec runs as root and leaves root-owned files.

required.description: The command may not run without a value (from the config, tests.txt or 'default').

default.description: Value used when none is given: a string, or {"changed-files": {...}}.

format.description: How a non-empty value is written into the command; '{{value}}' is the value. E.g. '--filter {{value}}' or '--config={{value}}'.

pattern.description: Regex the whole value must match (always checked as a full match). Required for a value to be accepted from tests.txt: without a pattern, only the config can set it.

value.description: A parameter value: a string, or the files changed on this ticket.

changed-files.description: The files changed on this ticket (tracked and new, not deleted), relative to the command's working-directory; files outside it are dropped.

if-none.description: No matching files: 'skip' the command, or 'run-without' the parameter.

model.description: Claude model alias or id, e.g. 'sonnet' or 'opus'.

allow-network.description: Anthropic hosts only, through the proxy.

mcp-config.description: MCP config file; null uses the repo's .mcp.json when a stage allows mcp__ tools.
